description: Insert a footnote or an endnote at a point in text, with its text (Type > Insert Footnote, Type > Insert Endnote). The reference number goes at the point; the note text follows the document's note options.

at.description: Where the reference goes: after the chosen text unless before is true

before.description: Use the point before the chosen text instead of the point after it

find.description: Text to find in the document (matched case-sensitively); the match is used

frameId.description: A text frame id; the text in that frame is used

length.description: With start: how many characters; 0 or absent means the point at start

occurrence.description: With find: which match to use, 1 for the first (default 1)

selection.description: Use the current text selection or text cursor

start.description: With storyId or frameId: the first character, counted from 0

storyId.description: A story id (get_document_stories lists them); its text is used

kind.description: Footnote (at the bottom of the column) or endnote (collected at the end)

name: insert_note
title: Insert Note
